title: Production opens the page guide by itself for new visitors, contrary to the recorded decision
steps: Production, read-only, fresh browser, no sign-in: open /landing and /marketplace (desktop 1350 px and Pixel 7).
Wait 4 s: #page-guide-description is visible and the .z-guide overlay covers the page.
GET /api/flags/page-guided-tours returns enabled_for_user:true. Locally (code default) the guide stays closed (first-visit-tours.json).
expected: As decided on 2026-11-06 (F-031): the guide opens only when the visitor taps the Page guide button.
actual: Production has the flag turned on (environment variable FF_PAGE_GUIDED_TOURS or an admin/Redis override), so the guide covers the landing page and marketplace on every first visit. Lighthouse reports the guide text as the landing page's LCP element (3.2 s).
impact: Every new visitor meets an overlay before seeing the product; first impressions and the landing LCP suffer. The running configuration contradicts a recorded owner decision.
fix: Owner decision: either turn the flag off on production (remove FF_PAGE_GUIDED_TOURS / reset the admin override) or record a new decision in DECISIONS.md. Add the flag value to scripts/prod-verify.cjs so drift is caught.
